fetchMemberProfile:
query fetchMemberProfile($firebaseId: String!) {
  member(where: {firebaseId: $firebaseId}) {
    id
    firebaseId
    email
    name
    gender
    birthday
    phone
    country
    city
    district
    address
    __typename
  }
}
fetchPaymentDataOfPapermag:
mutation fetchPaymentDataOfPapermag($data: createNewebpayTradeInfoForMagazineOrderInput!) {
  createNewebpayTradeInfoForMagazineOrder(data: $data) {
    MerchantID
    RespondType
    TimeStamp
    Version
    MerchantOrderNo
    Amt
    ItemDesc
    LoginType
    Email
    TradeLimit
    NotifyURL
    __typename
  }
}
magazineOrder:
query magazineOrder($orderNumber: String!) {
  magazineOrders(where: {orderNumber: {equals: $orderNumber}}) {
    id
    orderNumber
    purchaseDatetime
    merchandise {
      name
      code
      price
      __typename
    }
    itemCount
    totalAmount
    purchaseName
    purchaseEmail
    purchaseMobile
    receiveName
    receiveMobile
    receiveAddress
    createdAt
    totalAmount
    promoteCode
    __typename
  }
}
